full.description: This is a micrograph showing a histological section stained with H&E. The image displays the muscular walls of a blood vessel or tissue infiltrated and expanded by well-circumscribed nodules or fascicles of smooth muscle cells separated by dense collagen bundles. The findings are characteristic of an angioleiomyoma. The histological architecture shows intersecting bundles of smooth muscle cells with interspersed vascular channels.

random.description: This is a histological micrograph stained with hematoxylin and eosin. It shows liver tissue infiltrated by dense lymphocytic aggregates alongside bands of fibrous connective tissue. The pathological findings are characteristic of primary sclerosing cholangitis.
